description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
We are seeking a dedicated and technically skilled Maintenance Technician to support our state-of-the-art system-based testing platforms. In this role, you will be the backbone of our CPU validation labs, ensuring that complex test benches, validation motherboards, and custom emulation platforms operate at peak performance, minimizing downtime during critical silicon bring-up and verification cycles.
Key Responsibilities
• System Maintenance and Upkeep: Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on complex CPU validation platforms, test benches, and custom fixtures.
• Troubleshooting and Repair: Diagnose hardware failures down to the component level on custom test boards, power delivery networks, and interface cards using lab equipment like oscilloscopes, DMMs, and logic analyzers.
• Lab Support and Setup: Assemble, configure, and deploy new system-based testing platforms and test environments in collaboration with validation and design engineering teams.
• Inventory and Spare Parts Management: Monitor lab inventory, manage critical spare parts (sockets, cables, power supplies), and coordinate with vendors for replacements.
• Safety and Compliance: Ensure all lab operations and testing platforms adhere strictly to internal safety protocols and industry standards.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a technical degree B.Sc. program (e.g., Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electronics/ Electrical) at an accredited academic institution.

- Strong logical problem-solving and analytical capabilities.

- Proficiency in English communication, including reading, writing, and speaking.

- Demonstrated skills in attention to detail, teamwork, and self-directed learning.

- Availability to work a minimum of 4 days per week, with at least 2 years remaining until graduation.

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior hands-on technical experience in a relevant field such as electronics, software, or mechanical engineering.

- Practical engineering background in troubleshooting and diagnostic processes.

- Leadership capabilities, including the ability to coordinate and collaborate effectively in team settings.

We encourage you to apply if you're excited about contributing to impactful projects, gaining hands-on technical experience, and growing your skills in a collaborative environment dedicated to technological excellence.

Student / Intern

Shift 1 (Israel)

Primary Location:
Israel, Haifa

description:
Company:
Qualcomm Israel Ltd.

Job Area:
Interns Group, Interns Group > Engineering Intern

General Summary:

We are looking for a motivated third-year Electrical Engineering student to join our Digital Design team. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital chip design and RTL development while learning industry-standard design methodologies and tools. You will work alongside experienced design engineers and contribute to the development and implementation of advanced semiconductor designs.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist in Digital design, development, and integration of digital hardware blocks.

- Support the team in running design checks, simulations, synthesis, and analysis.

- Help debug design issues and validate functionality in collaboration with design and verification engineers.

- Develop simple automation scripts using Python or similar scripting languages.

- Document design specifications, processes, and technical results.

- Learn and apply industry-standard digital design methodologies, HDL languages, and design tools through hands- on project work.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering in the third year with at least four semesters remaining before completing studies.

- Strong understanding of digital logic and hardware design principles.

- Familiarity with programming or scripting in Python at a basic level.

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively and learn quickly in a team environment.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

- Exposure to Verilog or System-Verilog through academic coursework, projects, or personal experience.

- Interest in digital hardware design, RTL development, and semiconductor design.

- Familiarity with a UNIX development environment.

- Basic understanding of concepts such as timing, synthesis, and computer architecture.

Learning Opportunities

- Training in RTL design methodologies and industry-standard design tools.

- Hands-on experience with digital design, simulation, synthesis, debugging, and integration.

- Exposure to the complete hardware development lifecycle, from microarchitecture and RTL development through design validation and implementation.

- Mentorship from senior design engineers and exposure to real-world semiconductor projects.

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a world-class semiconductor development team working on next-generation technologies

- Gain real-world hardware design experience that complements your academic studies.

- Work on challenging digital and processor-related designs.

- Learn from industry experts and develop skills that directly apply to a future career in semiconductor engineering

- Enjoy a supportive and collaborative environment focused on learning, growth, and innovation.

PLEASE ENSURE THAT YOU ATTACH YOUR FULL GRADE SHEET TO YOUR CV & APPLICATION.

אנחנו טבע

אנחנו טבע, חברת ביו-פרמצבטית חדשנית ומובילה, המתבססת על מנוע גנרי ברמה עולמית. בין אם מדובר בחדשנות בתחומי מדעי המוח והאימונולוגיה או אספקת תרופות באיכות גבוהה, אנו מחויבים לתת מענה לצרכי המטופלים עכשיו ובעתיד. כאן, תהיו חלק מתרבות מכילה השואפת למצוינות, המעריכה חשיבה רעננה ושיתופי פעולה. יהיה לך מקום לצמוח, את הגמישות לאזן בין הבית לעבודה, ואת ההזדמנות להשפיע על בריאות טובה יותר ברחבי העולם, ביחד.

איך יראה היום שלך

- אחריות שוטפת על תכנון העבודה בכלל המערכות התפעוליות במרכז הלוגיסטי.

- ניהול הפעילות הלוגיסטית במערכת WMS, כולל יצירת מנגנוני עבודה בגלי ליקוט בשילוב מערכות האוטומציה Knapp ו־WCS.

- תכנון ובקרה על זרימת המשטחים, אחסונם ושליפתם, תוך ביצוע אופטימיזציה של המערכת ואיתור תקלות בזמן אמת.

- בקרה וניהול תקלות ותלונות, מתן מענה שוטף לגורמים תפעוליים.

- בנייה ויישום דוחות BI לשיפור נראות הנתונים ותהליכי קבלת החלטות.

- הרצת מגוון דוחות תפעוליים לצורך זיהוי תקלות, מדידת ביצועים ושיפור תפוקות המערך.

הכישורים והניסיון שיש לך

- סטודנט/ית להנדסת תעשייה וניהול / לוגיסטיקה / מנהל עסקים – יתרת לימודים של שנתיים לפחות (חובה)

- ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות, בניית דוחות, חדרי בקרה ובקרה לוגיסטית - יתרון משמעותי

- אנגלית ברמה טובה - קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור

- יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ובסביבה מרובת ממשקים

- נכונות לעבודה במשמרות (בוקר ערב ולילה ) - לפחות 3 משמרות בשבוע

איך אנחנו דואגים לך

בטבע, בריאות טובה יותר מתחילה מבפנים. מהיום הראשון, מקבלים אצלנו תמיכה בהטבות שנועדו לעזור לך לשגשג בעבודה ומעבר לה. זה כולל חופשה שנתית נדיבה, תוכניות תגמול, גמישות, גישה לתמיכה רפואית מותאמת אישית ודרכים משמעותיות לתרום לקהילה.כשזה מגיע לקריירה שלך, יעודדו אותך לחקור, להתפתח ולעצב את הדרך שלך. "טוויסט", הפלטפורמה הפנימית שלנו לפיתוח קריירה, מעניקה לך גישה למגוון רחב של אפשרויות, החל מתוכניות למידה ופרויקטים קצרי טווח ועד להזדמנויות לצמיחה. כאן, לוקחים חלק מתרבות שמעצימה אותך להשיג את היעדים שלך ולתעדף את הרווחה שלך בכל שלב בדרך.

מדווח ל

Mgr SC Sub-Function

עובד/ת טבע?

יש להגיש מועמדות דרך "טוויסט", הפלטפורמה הפנימית שלנו לפיתוח קריירה.

מחוייבות טבע להזדמנות שווה בתעסוקה / بتكافؤ الفرص

טבע תעשיות פרמצבטיות מחויבת למתן הזדמנות תעסוקה שווה לכל. כחלק ממדיניות ההעסקה הגלובלית של החברה, אנו מחויבים לתת הזדמנות שווה מבלי להתייחס לגיל, גזע, דת, אמונה, צבע עור, מגדר, מוגבלויות, הריון, מצב רפואי, נטייה מינית, זהות או צורת ביטוי מגדרית, מוצא, זהות לאומית או אתנית או כל סטאטוס חוקי אחר הזכאי להגנה תחת החוקים החלים עלינו.

description:
About the role:

Forter is looking for a Recovery Analyst Student to join our team and help increase our merchants' margins by fighting fraud chargebacks.

As a member of our growing

Recoveries team, you will build and submit dispute cases to recover funds on behalf of our merchants.

You'll work hands-on across payment platform portals, track each case through to its outcome, and help us keep our success rates high.

Most of our process is automated, and this role owns the part that still requires a person.

We are looking for a results-driven person with strong attention to detail, a high sense of responsibility, and a strong teamwork mentality.

What You'll Be Doing

Become an expert in fraud chargebacks and recovery.

Manage end-to-end dispute workflows directly across multiple payment platform portals.

Track, update, and maintain accurate dispute statuses to ensure seamless operational tracking.

Monitor chargeback outcomes to identify recurring patterns and support team performance improvements.

Contribute ideas to improve our performance and streamline and automate our processes, using

AI tools.

About Forter:
Forter is a human-first, AI-built company.

Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey - from sign-up to checkout to returns - that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously.

The world's most trusted brands - Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them - rely on Forter.

Since 2013 the company has raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today powers commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally.

Hybrid work:

Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week.

description:
Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon that powers Amazon's machine learning accelerators. Our Machine Learning Israel (MLIL) Firmware team in Tel Aviv develops the low-level firmware that brings these ML servers to life — from board management and boot flows to device management and health monitoring across the platform.

We are looking for a Software Development Student to join us part-time alongside your studies. You will work on real firmware that ships on production ML servers, writing and testing code, debugging on real hardware, and learning how large-scale accelerator platforms are built from the ground up. You will be working closely with silicon, hardware, and cloud teams to bring new accelerator platforms from first power-on to production. You will be paired with experienced engineers who will mentor you, review your code, and help you grow.

This is a hands-on role for a student who is curious about how hardware and software meet, enjoys solving problems at a low level, and wants to make a real impact on systems used at massive scale.

About the team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Early Career Talent

When you join Amazon Web Services as a student or recent graduate, you’ll have the chance for your voice to be heard and amplified. That’s because our teams are looking to learn as much from you as you’ll learn from them. Whether you’re graduating with a high school or equivalent diploma, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, MBA, or PhD, we offer a range of early career opportunities across the globe.

Basic qualifications
- Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon that powers Amazon's machine learning accelerators. Our Machine Learning Israel (MLIL) Firmware team in Tel Aviv develops the low-level firmware that brings these ML servers to life — from board management and boot flows to device management and health monitoring across the platform.

- We are looking for a Software Development Student to join us part-time alongside your studies. You will work on real firmware that ships on production ML servers, writing and testing code, debugging on real hardware, and learning how large-scale accelerator platforms are built from the ground up. You will be working closely with silicon, hardware, and cloud teams to bring new accelerator platforms from first power-on to production. You will be paired with experienced engineers who will mentor you, review your code, and help you grow.

- This is a hands-on role for a student who is curious about how hardware and software meet, enjoys solving problems at a low level, and wants to make a real impact on systems used at massive scale.

Preferred qualifications
- Programming experience in C / C++

- Experience with Linux, embedded systems, firmware, or low-level programming

- Exposure to hardware debugging, communication protocols (I2C, PCIe, SPI), or device drivers

- Demonstrated early adopter of AI-assisted development tools- uses LLMs or code-generation agents as part of daily workflow

- Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn in a hardware-focused environment

- Team player, highly motivated, passionate about SW development, and a fast self-learner

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
